Tubular or trochar discectomy is a less invasive technique in which a tubular retractor is inserted over a guidewire, gaining access to the disc by muscle splitting rather than muscle incision and detachment. Clinical support tools to assist in the tracking and monitoring of patient outcomes and education around patient risks and preventive measures to better coordinate care for the member and reduce infection rates and complications due to patient comorbidities. Provider performance reporting and analytics that give physicians and practice administrators greater visibility and transparency into their performance compared to the practice and similar peer Specialty practices, as well as the rest of the market. FDA recall tracking and monitoring to facilitate timely and consistent notification to the physician, patient and to Peach State when a member has received or needs a revision surgery due to a Class I or II FDA device recall.
